titulo_es.@es: Colocaciones con make, do, take y pay
titulo_es.@en: Placements with make, do, take and pay

texto.@es: **Make** aparece en **make a decision**, **make an effort** y **make progress**; **do**, en tareas o favores: **do homework** y **do someone a favour**. Son combinaciones frecuentes, no una regla que sirva para todos los nombres. **Progress** es incontable: no se dice *a progress* ni *progresses* con este sentido.
texto.@en: **Make** appears in **make a decision**, **make an effort** and **make progress**; **do**, in tasks or favors: **do homework** and **do someone a favour**. They are frequent combinations, not a rule that serves all names. **Progress** is countless: it is not said * a progress * nor * progress * in this sense.

texto.@es: Aprende estas combinaciones: **take responsibility for** a mistake, **take care of** a person or task y **take part in** a meeting. Las preposiciones forman parte del bloque.
texto.@en: Learn these combinations: **take responsibility for** a mistake, **take care of** a person or task and **take part in** a meeting. Prepositions are part of the block.

texto.@es: **Pay attention to** significa «prestar atención a»; conserva la preposición **to**.
texto.@en: **Pay attention to** means «pay attention to»; it retains the **to** preposition.

intro.@es: Las colocaciones son combinaciones frecuentes. Conviene aprender las palabras juntas: traducir cada palabra por separado no siempre permite elegir el verbo correcto.
intro.@en: Placements are frequent combinations. It is appropriate to learn the words together: translating each word separately does not always allow you to choose the right verb.
